author: reek
body: A codegen regression. A recursive function whose body is a `when` needs its return address saved when an arm makes a NON-tail call, even though another arm makes a tail call that would let it skip the frame's ra. my-filter is the smallest shape: the ICons arm's then-branch conses the recursive result (`ICons h (my-filter pred t)`, non-tail) while its else-branch is a tail call. On RISC-V the plug's ra-need analysis had no IrMatch arm, answered "no ra needed", elided the save, and my-filter looped back into itself on return -- stopping the program mid-output. my-map (arm conses a value, no tail call) always worked; sum-real (a pure tail loop, no non-tail call) must keep skipping ra. Reduced from list-test.
